name: Philippines (procedural integrity)
description: Procedural integrity indicators using mPhilGEPS normalized tables (postponements, documents, contracts, bid validity)

indicators.name: Postponement with short rebid window
indicators.description: After tender postponement, new submission period shorter than mode-specific minimum.
indicators.tracks: Bid window compression following a tender postponement or amendment.

computation.summary: amendments/date present AND days(endDate − startDate) < mode threshold
steps: Detect tender/amendments from postponement or supplement records.
Recompute submission period after amendment date.
Compare to RA 9184 minimum notice by procurementMethodDetails.

indicators.interpretation: Postponements used to shorten effective notice warrant procedural review.
indicators.limitations: Not available on flat CSV export; requires normalized PhilGEPS tables.

indicators.name: Amendment without rationale
indicators.description: Tender amended (supplement or postponement) but amendments/rationale is empty.
indicators.tracks: Missing justification text for tender amendments.

computation.summary: tender/amendments/id present AND amendments/rationale absent or blank

indicators.interpretation: Audit trail gap — stakeholders cannot see why terms or dates changed.

indicators.name: Competitive notice without tender documents
indicators.description: Open or selective procedure with no published tender documents.
indicators.tracks: Competitive notice missing TOR/ITB or other tender documents.

steps: Check tender/documents for id, url, or datePublished.

indicators.interpretation: Transparency failure — bidders cannot access full tender pack.

indicators.name: Non-open award without reason
indicators.description: Non-competitive method with missing award justification (Reason of Award / awardCriteria).
indicators.tracks: Negotiated or direct award without documented justification.

steps: Read tender/awardCriteria (mapped from Reason of Award in mPhilGEPS).
Flag missing or generic justification strings.

indicators.interpretation: RA 9184 expects documented basis for non-competitive awards.

indicators.name: Award beyond bid validity
indicators.description: Award date falls outside the published bid validity period.
indicators.tracks: Whether award occurred after bids were no longer valid.

steps: Read tender period start and bid validity (enquiryPeriod/durationInDays or equivalent).

indicators.interpretation: Procedural invalidity — award may require rebidding under RA 9184.

indicators.name: Contract period mismatch across stages
indicators.description: Material disagreement between tender, award, and contract period durations.
indicators.tracks: Inconsistent contract duration published at tender, award, and contract stages.

computation.summary: |tender.contractPeriod − awards.contractPeriod| > tolerance OR contract period dates inconsistent
steps: Read contracts/period/startDate and endDate when present.

indicators.interpretation: May indicate scope change, amendment not reflected, or mapping error.

indicators.name: Long award-to-contract start delay
indicators.description: Unusually long gap between award notice and contract period start.
indicators.tracks: Delay between award publication and contract effectivity.

steps: Flag delays above configured threshold (e.g. 90 days).

indicators.interpretation: Implementation slippage or contracts not yet executed.
indicators.limitations: Contract dates ~36% fill on flat CSV; strongest on normalized DB.
